Package com.noorlandmc.NoorMenus.menu

Class MenuRuntimeService

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorMenus.menu.MenuRuntimeService
public final class MenuRuntimeService extends Object
Manages menu registration, persistence, and runtime customization. Handles storing/loading menu overrides from disk and applying them to inventories.
